recorded.prompt:q-iadd: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-iadd: 5.2.1 'Read += with care': 'a row that lost its <= quietly becomes the new objective.' Also: 'Handed a linear expression, it sets the objective.'
recorded.prompt:q-codes: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-codes: Rule list: 'status == LpStatusOptimal and sol_status == LpSolutionIntegerFeasible: a plan that keeps every row, but the search stopped before proving it best.'
recorded.prompt:q-port: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-port: Check 1: 'The same optimal value, with both solvers at a gap of 0. At the default gap ... two correct models can then disagree.'

Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-iadd:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-iadd:a: 'Handed a linear expression, it sets the objective'; it becomes the objective, not an unbounded row.
recorded.prompt:q-iadd:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-iadd:c: 'quietly becomes the new objective', so there is no error.
recorded.prompt:q-iadd:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-iadd:d: The expression is not ignored. It 'quietly becomes the new objective.'
recorded.prompt:q-codes:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-codes:a: 'CBC stopped after one node ... and status still says Optimal'. 'Only sol_status tells a finished search from a stopped one.'
recorded.prompt:q-codes:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-codes:b: LpSolution maps 2 to 'Solution Found', and '2 is a solution with no proof.'
recorded.prompt:q-codes:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-codes:d: The same rule says the plan 'keeps every row'.
recorded.prompt:q-port:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-port:b: 'At the default gap, a solver may stop at a plan within its tolerance of the best, and two correct models can then disagree.'
recorded.prompt:q-port:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-port:c: 'Two optimal plans can differ when several tie, so plans are not compared directly.' Also, values are compared at gap 0.
recorded.prompt:q-port:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-port:d: Check 1 requires the same value 'with both solvers at a gap of 0', not agreement within the default gaps.
